class.name: PlacedPlant3D
class.description: Draws one variant of a species at the node's transform, like a single placement in a foliage tool, and keeps the procedural plants and stones (and grass, with [member clear_grass]) out of its footprint.

method.name: get_effective_clearance
method.description: The keep-out radius in use: [member clearance], or the species' footprint when that is negative.

members.member: Also keeps grass out of the footprint.
The keep-out radius in metres; negative uses the species' footprint.
Which of the species' meshes to draw.
